messages:
Nina: proposal: add `deploy-bot briefgen` to produce a compact release brief + suggested pins.yaml and a rollback snippet. Saves copy/paste during release prep.

Arjun: sounds useful. CLI sketch?

Nina: `deploy-bot briefgen --version v1.4.0 --canary 10 --changelog CHANGES.md --dry-run`

Nina: output should be three things in one: a one-paragraph release summary, 3 bullet highlights (PR titles), and a pins.yaml suggestion.

Marta: important: default to OUTPUT-ONLY. no auto apply. `--apply` must be explicit and require `--confirm`.

Deploy-Bot: preflight: no active rollouts on project/redwood-core. briefgen dry-run allowed. :white_check_mark:

Hannah: include a risk heuristic (low/med/high) based on whether image/model changed and how many files in infra/critical paths were modified.

Arjun: also add `--perf-snapshot` to fetch p99/qps and attach a small block for SRE to compare.

Nina: sample dry-run output: 
```
Release brief v1.4.0 (canary 10%)
Summary: Fixes a KV cache bug and improves batching; no breaking changes.

Highlights:
- Fix: KV cache illegal-read during burst writes (PR #902)
- Perf: dynamic batching reduces short-seq p99 by ~12% (PR #911)
- Ops: model fallback added for variant mismatch (PR #918)

Risk: medium (image + runtime change)

Suggested pins.yaml:
service: redwood-api:sha256:abcd1234
model: redwood-reason-v3:2025-01-10

Rollback snippet (rollback.sh):
#!/bin/bash
# revert to previous pins
deployctl apply --pin-file pins.prev.yaml --rollout 100
```

Marta: include `generated_by`, `timestamp`, and `source_commit` metadata in pins.yaml so we can track suggestions.

Hannah: add `--include-pr-links` opt-in flag (privacy) and `--email-draft` to emit a 1-2 sentence line for release notes.

Arjun: small UX thing: make the brief output in machine-friendly blocks (--- brief.md, --- pins.yaml, --- rollback.sh) so CI can consume it if needed.

Nina: agreed. Implementation plan: I'll draft a tiny PoC that parses CHANGES.md, hits GH for top PR titles, and composes the brief. Arjun will wire perf snapshot, Marta adds safety checks.

Marta: one more: `--skip-preflight` for emergency manual runs (requires `--confirm`) and a visible warning in the output.

Deploy-Bot: note: when `--apply` is used, an audit entry will be required.

Nina: thanks team. I'll open the PR with the CLI stub and examples. Ping here when ready for review.

Hannah: will review wording and can help craft the email draft.
